# BenAI Skills

Expert automation plugins for Claude Code.

## Installation

```bash
# Install plugins
/plugin install youtube-strategy@benai-skills-internal
/plugin install cowork-tools@benai-skills-internal
```

## Setup

The YouTube Strategy plugin requires an Apify API token for channel scraping and video data extraction.

Create a `.env` file in your project directory:

```bash
APIFY_TOKEN=your_token_here
```

Get your token at [Apify Console](https://console.apify.com).

**Important:** Add `.env` to your `.gitignore` to keep your API keys secure.

## Plugins

### YouTube Strategy (5 skills)

End-to-end YouTube content production workflow — from competitor research to final video outline.

| Skill | Command | Purpose |
|-------|---------|---------|
| yt-research | `/yt-research` | Research competitor channels, niches, trending topics |
| yt-ideation | `/yt-ideate` | Generate & validate video ideas within content pillars |
| yt-brief | `/yt-brief` | Refine idea into structured production brief |
| yt-packaging | `/yt-package` | Create optimized titles & thumbnail concepts |
| yt-outline | `/yt-outline` | Build step-by-step outlines with demo prep |

**Commands:** `/youtube-strategy` (skill overview), `/morning-routine` (daily content scan), `/yt-pipeline` (full Research → Ideate → Brief → Package → Outline workflow), plus per-skill commands above

**Agents:** `yt-scraper`, `channel-analyzer`, `idea-validator`, `morning-scanner`

#### Pipeline Flow

```
/yt-pipeline:
  Phase 0: Context (niche focus, competitor channels)
  Phase 1: Research (yt-scraper + channel-analyzer agents)
  Phase 2: Ideate (generate 15-20 ideas + idea-validator agents)
  Phase 3: Brief (define angle, key points, CTA asset)
  Phase 4: Package (5-10 titles, 3-5 thumbnail concepts)
  Phase 5: Outline (step-by-step outline + demo prep checklist)
```

Each phase has a mandatory human checkpoint before proceeding.

### Cowork Tools (1 skill)

Export and import Claude Desktop Cowork sessions as portable zip archives.

| Skill | Commands | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| cowork-porter | `/cowork-export`, `/cowork-import` | Transfer sessions between machines, share with teammates, or back up work |

## Project Structure

```
benai-skills/
├── .claude-plugin/
│   ├── marketplace.json          # Plugin registry (names, versions, keywords)
│   └── skills-map.json           # Maps skills, commands, connectors, agents to plugins
├── shared-skills/                # Source of truth for all skills
│   ├── cowork-porter/
│   ├── yt-brief/
│   ├── yt-ideation/
│   ├── yt-outline/
│   ├── yt-packaging/
│   └── yt-research/
├── commands/                     # Command .md files mapped in skills-map.json
│   ├── cowork-export.md
│   ├── cowork-import.md
│   ├── morning-routine.md
│   ├── youtube-strategy.md
│   ├── yt-brief.md
│   ├── yt-ideate.md
│   ├── yt-outline.md
│   ├── yt-package.md
│   ├── yt-pipeline.md
│   └── yt-research.md
├── agents/                       # Sub-agent definitions for pipelines
│   ├── channel-analyzer.md
│   ├── idea-validator.md
│   ├── morning-scanner.md
│   └── yt-scraper.md
├── connectors/                   # MCP server configs
│   └── apify.json
├── plugins/                      # Generated by sync-skills.sh — do not edit
│   ├── cowork-tools/
│   └── youtube-strategy/
├── sync-skills.sh                # Generates plugins/ from shared-skills/ + skills-map.json
├── build-zips.sh                 # Builds distributable zips (runs sync first)
├── CLAUDE.md
└── README.md
```

## Adding New Skills

1. Create the skill directory in `shared-skills/` with `SKILL.md` and optional `references/`
2. Add the skill to the relevant plugins in `.claude-plugin/skills-map.json`
3. If needed, add command `.md` files in `commands/` and map them in `skills-map.json`
4. Run `./sync-skills.sh` to generate plugin output

## Editing Existing Skills

1. Edit the skill in `shared-skills/<skill>/` (never in `plugins/*/skills/`)
2. Run `./sync-skills.sh` to propagate changes

**Before every push**, run `./sync-skills.sh` to ensure plugins are in sync.

## Building Distributable Zips

Run `./build-zips.sh` to generate downloadable zip files in `dist/`. The script runs `sync-skills.sh` first, then reads `marketplace.json` and creates:
- One extension zip per plugin in `dist/extension/`
- One desktop zip per plugin in `dist/desktop/`
